accountKey.title: Account
accountKey.scopeNotice: This covers only the account key that represents who you are. It does not include posts, settings, attachments, or private-channel secrets. Use Settings > Backup & restore to migrate a whole device or to prepare for device failure.

export.title: Export account key
export.warning: Anyone who obtains this export and its passphrase can fully impersonate you. If you forget the passphrase, no one — including the operators — can recover it. Store it only in a safe place.
export.passphraseHint: Choose a strong passphrase of at least {{min}} characters.

import.title: Import account key
import.alreadyRegistered: This key is already registered on this device.
import.success: Account added. Switch to it to start using the imported account.

deviceBackup.title: Device backup
deviceBackup.summary: Save and restore this device's data.
deviceBackup.oneFileNotice: One backup file contains one active account. Create a separate file for each account. Unlike key-only export, this also includes local posts, drafts, attachments, preferences, and private-channel secrets.
deviceBackup.secretNotice: Anyone with this file and passphrase may impersonate you and read private data. Store both safely. Restoring does not delete copies on the old device or the P2P network.
deviceBackup.keyOnlyHint: To move only your account key to another device, export it under Settings > Account. Use this backup to migrate a whole device or to prepare for device failure.
deviceBackup.passphraseHint: At least {{min}} characters. A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered.

create.title: Create backup
create.description: After you choose a destination, kukuri briefly stops the runtime and encrypts a consistent snapshot.
create.acknowledge: I understand this contains sensitive data and cannot be restored without the passphrase

restore.title: Restore from backup
restore.description: kukuri decrypts and validates the backup in staging, then switches accounts only after validation succeeds.
restore.reconsent: App terms, age attestation, Community Node policies, and adult-content display settings are not inherited and must be confirmed again.
restore.applyPreferences: Apply drafts, workspace, theme, and language preferences
restore.replaceExisting: I understand that the existing account with this public key will be replaced

indexNode.label: Community Index query node
indexNode.hint: Automatic uses the first eligible configured node. An explicit selection stops queries instead of silently switching when that node is unavailable.
indexNode.unavailable: The explicitly selected node is currently unavailable.

status.absent: This node does not publish a manifest

boundary.identityNotOwned: Your account, profile, follows, and posts are not owned by this node. The node only provides supporting features for the P2P network.
boundary.defaultNotAuthority: Even as a default node, it is not the operator or authority for the whole network.

contentAdvisory.label: Use this node's estimates of adult material
contentAdvisory.description: When on, posts this node estimates may contain adult material are also hidden behind a placeholder while adult material display is off. The estimate is this node’s judgment, not the poster’s label or a decision by kukuri as a whole.
contentAdvisory.enabled: The IDs of posts shown in your timelines and the identifiers of their attachments are sent to this node to check its estimates. Post text and browsing history are not sent.
contentAdvisory.disabled: This node is not asked for estimates, and its estimates are not used.

distanceOptout.title: Distance opt-out
distanceOptout.notEligible: Distance opt-out is unavailable for this node (authentication, required consent, connectivity, or index/trust provision is missing).
distanceOptout.description: When enabled, this node mutually suppresses surfacing between you and users beyond its displayed proximity boundary, helping avoid large-scale conflict amplification between distant communities.
distanceOptout.notPrivacy: This is reversible node-local display control. It is not a privacy feature, block, graph departure, P2P restriction, or network-wide invisibility guarantee.
distanceOptout.notLoaded: Load the current setting and node-local boundary before changing it.

errors.notConfigured: This Community Node does not provide relation distance opt-out.
errors.notActivated: Relation distance opt-out is temporarily unavailable on this Community Node.
errors.authRequired: Authentication with the selected Community Node is required.
errors.consentRequired: The selected Community Node requires accepting its mandatory policies.

distanceOptout.enabled: Enabled. The node-local minimum proximity is {{distance}}.
distanceOptout.disabled: Disabled. The node-local minimum proximity would be {{distance}}.

admission.inviteCodeSaved: An invite code is saved for this node. Its value is never displayed.

reasons.INVITE_REQUIRED: This node requires an invite code to join.
reasons.INVITE_INVALID: The invite code is not valid.
reasons.INVITE_EXHAUSTED: The invite code has reached its usage limit.
reasons.INVITE_REVOKED: The invite code has been revoked.
reasons.NOT_ALLOWLISTED: This node only admits accounts on its allowlist.
reasons.BANNED: This node has stopped providing support services to this account. This is not a network-wide ban.

nextSteps.INVITE_REQUIRED: Enter an invite code and authenticate again.
nextSteps.INVITE_INVALID: Check the code or obtain a new invite code and enter it.
nextSteps.INVITE_EXPIRED: Obtain a new invite code from the node operator.
nextSteps.INVITE_EXHAUSTED: Obtain an available invite code from the node operator.
nextSteps.INVITE_REVOKED: Obtain a new invite code from the node operator.
nextSteps.NOT_ALLOWLISTED: Ask the node operator to add your account to the allowlist.
nextSteps.BANNED: Contact this node's operator if needed. Automatic retries are stopped.

onboarding.title: What is a community node?
onboarding.description: A community node is a server that helps you find other people and connect their devices. It can also relay communication when devices cannot connect directly. Features such as search and discovery vary by node. Review the terms of the node before using it.

observationSharing.title: Sharing blocks and mutes
observationSharing.description: Share the blocks and mutes you made on this device with this node. Only this node receives them, and they only affect what people close to you see.
observationSharing.enabled: Sharing. Stopping asks this node to delete the records it stores.
observationSharing.includeExisting: Also send my current blocks and mutes
observationSharing.dialogIntro: Accepting this document starts sharing. It is optional and you can stop at any time.
observationSharing.needsReconsent: Sharing stopped because this node's document changed. Accept it again to resume.
observationSharing.revocationPending: Waiting for the deletion request to finish. Sharing stays off until it does.
observationSharing.failed: Could not change the sharing setting. Try again later.

trustPriority.title: Nodes that collapse posts by trust
trustPriority.description: Adopt the trust value from the selected nodes in order, and collapse posts from people they rate low. Nothing is collapsed when none are selected. Values from different nodes are never mixed.
trustPriority.none: Nothing is selected, so no post is collapsed by trust.

logs.capture: When started from a terminal, the same logs also go to standard output (example: RUST_LOG=info kukuri).

externalTransmission.summary: These are the main situations in which the app communicates outside your device. Review each configured Community Node's disclosures below for Node-specific handling.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.summary: Keys that are assigned today, and the screen or focus each one needs. Every action is also available with the mouse.

esc.action: Close the composer. The draft, reply target, and destination are kept.
esc.condition: Focus is inside the composer, mention suggestions are closed, and no IME composition is active

ctrlEnter.condition: Focus is in the text field, there is text or an attachment, and nothing is sending. During IME composition it only confirms the text

tab.action: Move to the next control (Shift+Tab moves back).
tab.condition: Inside the composer: Close, text, Choose files, adult label, then the send button

arrows.condition: You typed @ in the text and suggestions are open

enter.action: Pick the mention suggestion (Tab does the same). Without suggestions it inserts a line break.
enter.condition: Focus is in the text field

esc.action: Close settings, the Control Center, dialogs, and menus. When focus is outside a text field it also closes thread and profile details.

tab.condition: Focus is at the top of the page

columnMenu.action: Open a Column menu and move through its items (Home / End jump to the ends, Esc closes).
columnMenu.condition: Focus is on a Column menu button or item

timelineTabs.condition: Focus is on the view tabs

postMenu.action: Open the post action menu (the Menu key works too).
postMenu.condition: Focus is on a post card

media.action: Go to the previous or next media item.
media.condition: A media item is open in the viewer

keyboard.unassigned: Other keys (for example ?, Ctrl+/, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+N) are not assigned yet.

safety.title: Safety
safety.summary: Adult material display, plus user mute and block.

adultContent.label: Show media and posts self-labeled as adult material
adultContent.description: While this is off, kukuri does not download or display media attached to posts that were self-labeled as adult material, and shows a placeholder instead. Labels are self-declared by the people who post; an unlabeled post is not guaranteed to be free of adult material. This preference is stored only on this device and is separate from the age self-attestation.

social.title: Mute and block
social.mute: Mute hides a user's posts, streams, and rooms on this device only. It is not synced to other devices and the user is not told.
social.block: Block is signed with your account and synced to your other devices. Once each side has received the block, both of you stop seeing each other's posts, streams, and rooms, and they cannot enter your Dome. Their posts are still fetched; only the display is hidden.

states.durable: Sync activity recorded · current connection unconfirmed

descriptions.unknown: Connection diagnostics have not loaded yet. This does not mean there are no peers or that a topic has never been used.
descriptions.live: A live connection is available. Check the topic details for individual connections.
descriptions.durable: There is no live connection. Stored-data sync activity was recorded, but this does not guarantee a current connection.
descriptions.recovering: There is no live connection. Stored-data delivery is recovering. Configured assistance does not mean a peer connection has been established.
descriptions.offline: There is no live connection. Configured connection candidates are separate from connected peers.
descriptions.paused: Live reception for this topic is paused. Viewing or refreshing diagnostics does not resume it.
descriptions.preparing: This topic is subscribed, but its diagnostics have not arrived yet.
descriptions.unsubscribed: This topic is not currently subscribed. Diagnostics do not establish whether it was used in the past.

steps.unknown: Refresh diagnostics to check the state.
steps.live: If a topic is having trouble, check its individual diagnostics.
steps.durable: Check that someone on the same topic is online, wait briefly, then refresh diagnostics.
steps.recovering: Wait briefly and refresh diagnostics. If this continues, check peers on the same topic or community node settings. A ready node does not guarantee a peer connection.
steps.offline: Check that someone on the same topic is online, wait briefly, then refresh diagnostics. You can also check connection settings.
steps.paused: To resume, enable live reception from the topic actions in Control Center.
steps.unsubscribed: To use this topic, open it from Control Center, then refresh diagnostics.

discovery.description: This shows peer discovery, not individual topic delivery. Seeds and assistance peers are candidates. Allowing relay does not mean data is currently relayed.

connectionGuidance.stale: Diagnostics could not be refreshed. Showing the previous snapshot; the current state is unconfirmed.
connectionGuidance.failed: Diagnostics could not be loaded. Try refreshing again.
connectionGuidance.candidates: Configured candidates and assistance peers are not counted as connected peers.
connectionGuidance.topicLive: This topic has a live connection.
connectionGuidance.operationError: Another app operation failed. This is separate from the current connection state.
